edges.reason: from parameter is read by Jinx._transfer to validate and route the transfer.
to parameter is read by Jinx._transfer to validate and route the transfer.
amount parameter is read and reduced by fees inside Jinx._transfer.
contractTokenBalance is computed and compared against the swap threshold in _transfer.
canSwap gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
sellTokens is derived from the contract balance inside _transfer.
takeFee gates whether a fee is deducted in _transfer.
fees local holds the deducted fee transferred to the contract.
amount feeds the fee arithmetic amount.mul(1200).div(10000) whose result is subtracted from amount.
from is used to look up fee exclusion status in _isExcluded.
to is used to look up fee exclusion status in _isExcluded.
from is compared against the uniswapV2Pair to decide fee/swap behaviour.
to is compared against the uniswapV2Pair to decide fee/swap behaviour.
sellTokens is passed as the tokens argument of swapAndSendDividends.
tokens parameter is forwarded into swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount is used for approval and the router swap call.
path array is built and passed to the router swap.
block.timestamp is used as the Uniswap swap deadline, making execution time miner-dependent.
tokenAmount flows into the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
swapAndSendDividends consumes the ETH produced by swapTokensForEth.
The contract ETH balance obtained by the swap is sent to owner().
_user array is iterated in the airdrop loop.
_amount array supplies transfer values in the airdrop loop.
len bounds the airdrop loop and is checked against _amount.length.
amount parameter is written into swapTokensAtAmount.
setSwapAtAmount writes the swapTokensAtAmount state variable.
swapTokensAtAmount is read to compute canSwap in _transfer.
_msgSender returns the caller-controlled msg.sender.
airdrop uses _msgSender() as the source of the transferred tokens.
msg.sender is compared with _owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
swapping guard is read and written around the swap branch of _transfer.
Constructor local router is assigned to the uniswapV2Router state variable.
Constructor local pair is assigned to the immutable uniswapV2Pair.
Base _transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on _balances entries.
_mint adds to _totalSupply using SafeMath.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer conditionally calls swapAndSendDividends when the balance threshold is met.
Jinx._transfer calls super._transfer (base ERC20 _transfer) to move balances.
airdrop invokes super._transfer for each recipient.
setSwapAtAmount is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
airdrop is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
Constructor mints the initial supply.
Constructor makes an external factory createPair call.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization check.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
Public ERC20 transfer delegates to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to internal _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
External router swap executes while the contract holds tokens/ETH; a re-entrant call could re-enter _transfer, only mitigated by the transient bool swapping flag.
Sending the entire contract ETH balance to owner() is an external interaction that can invoke receiver logic and re-enter token transfer paths.
External factory createPair call during construction can cause a callback into constructor context; no state is exploitable at that point.
